title: The agent's account may read and search every case, not the caseload of the acting case worker
consequence: One hijacked run reaches the cases of a whole town (R02)

title: The agent may email any address and request any host
consequence: A record can leave by email or inside a web address (R01)

title: The runtime sits in the case-database tier and has a route to the internet
consequence: Whatever the policy says, Restricted data and the internet meet in one process
